goal.objective: Plan and, after the user switches to Build mode, implement proper discoverable OpenCode tool definitions for this repository's desktop screenshot and AT-SPI computer-use capabilities, preserving safety boundaries and verifying tool discovery and behavior.

plan.summary: Expose repository-native computer-use as typed OpenCode v2 tools, rather than relying solely on skill prose and shell commands; scope the initial implementation to the native GNOME host, preserving screenshot privacy and AT-SPI preview/apply behavior.
completionCriteria: A fresh OpenCode session in the intended scope discovers correctly named and schema-defined desktop screenshot and accessibility tools, without duplicate or conflicting registration.
A real screenshot tool invocation returns a model-viewable image and removes only its own transient capture; privacy preconditions and ambiguous-file failures are enforced.
AT-SPI read-only calls work and state-changing calls preserve the existing complete-search, target-token, preview/apply, protected-field, and verification gates.
Configuration, skills, docs, and health checks match the actual implemented surface; focused tests and a fresh-session smoke test pass without modifying unrelated work.

phases.objective: Confirm the exact OpenCode tool contract, runtime scope, and existing computer-use safety boundaries.

tasks.description: Read canonical desktop utility, screenshot workflows, active config/runtime, and any existing plugin packaging or tests; distinguish GNOME native from WSL capabilities.
tasks.evidence: Read desktop-control.py fully, both desktop skill guides, project/global config, AGENTS.md, plugin docs, MCP docs, and attachment docs. Confirmed native GNOME Wayland with active ydotool and socket, AT-SPI apps/tree working, and only github/playwright MCPs registered.

tasks.description: Verify V2 plugin tool registration, image/file result format, Code Mode discovery, and permission mechanisms against official docs and runtime; select smallest native plugin or local MCP design and decide project vs global scope without duplicates.
tasks.evidence: V2 docs verify repo-local .opencode/tools TypeScript definitions auto-load, tool() schemas, and file attachments with image/png data URLs; global deployed tools/vision.ts and tools/desktop.ts provide a working precedent. Chose repo-local .opencode/tools adapters calling the canonical Python script, avoiding duplicate registration and keeping Python as the sole AT-SPI safety implementation.

phases.verification: Verified official V2 plugin/tool, MCP, config, and attachment contracts plus local runtime versions (opencode v2.1.1, Node 22.22.2) and direct execution evidence.

phases.objective: Implement typed screenshot and AT-SPI tool definitions with bounded adapters and update canonical configuration/docs.

tasks.description: Add a canonical repo-local tool provider with explicit JSON schemas, stable names, bounded inputs, cancellation/timeouts, and no arbitrary shell or unrestricted screenshot paths.
tasks.evidence: Added .opencode/plugins/computer-use/{index,desktop,screenshot,logic.test}.ts; plugin registers namespace desktop with desktop_screenshot/apps/tree/find/act, JSON schemas with additionalProperties:false, bounds, AbortSignal cancellation, timeouts, and output caps. Probe of ctx.tool.list() returned all five ids.

tasks.description: Implement single-capture GNOME path with pre/post inventory, safe PNG validation, image return, exact cleanup, and fail-closed privacy behavior; do not claim WSL support unless its trusted backend exists.
tasks.evidence: captureOnce does pre/post inventory, refuses ambiguity without deleting, reads then always unlinks that exact name, validates 6 MiB cap plus PNG signature/IHDR dims, and returns a data URL. Live run captured 2466x1664 484 KiB, screenshot count 27->27, no leftover.

tasks.description: Wrap existing desktop-control.py functionality in typed read-only and preview/apply tools, retaining token freshness and sensitive-field restrictions.
tasks.evidence: desktop.ts validates verb/field combinations, rejects mutation fields on read verbs, caps text/depth/nodes/wait, and delegates to desktop-control.py. Live checks: tree/find read output, preview returned dry_run with target_token, apply without token rejected, stale token rejected.

tasks.description: Register the provider in canonical V2 config for the chosen scope; reconcile desktop skills, catalog, setup guide and health check to describe actual tool availability and dependencies.
tasks.evidence: Plugin auto-loads from .opencode/plugins (no config change needed); updated AGENTS.md, README.md, setup.md, skills/README.md, and both desktop skill SKILL.md/README pairs; health-check.sh now asserts plugin files and runs the node tests.

phases.verification: node --test 15/15 pass, health-check.sh PASSED, bash -n and py_compile clean, git diff --check clean, plugin reload logs show no errors.

phases.objective: Prove tool discovery, safe execution, cleanup, and no regressions in a fresh Build-mode session.

tasks.description: Run focused tests for tool schemas, input rejection, screenshot ambiguity/cleanup, token expiry and apply behavior, and existing script checks plus git diff --check.
tasks.evidence: node --test .opencode/plugins/computer-use/logic.test.ts: 15 pass / 0 fail. health-check.sh PASSED including plugin files and the new test step. bash -n scripts/*.sh and python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py clean. git diff --check clean.

tasks.description: Verify live tool inventory in a fresh OpenCode session, one safe screenshot returning an image with exact cleanup, AT-SPI app/tree/find reads, and a harmless preview; verify GUI mutation only if an appropriate safe target is available.
tasks.evidence: Tool registration proven via ctx.tool.list() probe (all five desktop_* ids) with the plugin loading error-free. Live capture and AT-SPI read/preview/apply-gate behaviour verified with real desktop. Native tool exposure in a brand-new model turn was not directly observable from inside this session; this needs the user's fresh session to confirm.

tasks.description: Inspect final diff/status and report verified coverage, limitations, and any activation/restart steps; do not commit or push without separate approval.
tasks.evidence: git status shows 9 modified tracked files plus the new .opencode/plugins/ directory; git diff --check clean; no probe or temp artifacts remain; nothing committed or pushed. Reported verified coverage and the one unverified item (fresh-session native exposure).

phases.verification: Fresh repo-location sessions called desktop_apps, desktop_screenshot, and desktop_act natively with real output; screenshot returned a model-visible image (model reported 2466x1664) and left the screenshot directory unchanged at 27 files; test run 15/15, health-check PASSED, git diff --check clean; probe sessions deleted.

decisions: Plan-mode restriction: no implementation or plan file writes now; goal remains paused until Build mode and explicit resume.
Prefer a V2 plugin tool transform if image results and per-session permissions are verified; a local MCP is an alternative only if plugin tool output cannot provide the required image contract.
Default initial platform scope is native GNOME where the previous test proved ydotool and AT-SPI availability; WSL Windows bridge support needs separate verified host source.
Project registration first to avoid unexpectedly enabling desktop control in unrelated projects; confirm global use before extending global configuration.

Keep plugin tool options at codemode:false (documented direct exposure) and leave completion criterion 1 for the user's fresh-session confirmation rather than switching to codemode:true purely for in-session verifiability.
Native exposure (codemode:false) confirmed end-to-end via opencode run in the repo location; no switch to Code Mode needed.
